nodes.name: Pre-cleaning and corrosion soaking
nodes.procedure: Ni foam (NF, Suzhou Jiashide Co. Ltd., ≥99.99%, thickness of 1.0 mm) was washed with 3 M HCl, EtOH, and acetone solutions to remove nickel oxide and hydrocarbons on the surface. First, 1.00 g of (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O, 0.10 g of polyvinylpyrrolidone, and 0.10 g of NH4F were dissolved in 30 ml of deionised water to form a colourless solution. A pre-cleaned NF (1.5 × 2.5 cm) was soaked in the colourless solution and shaken at 25 °C for 2 h to form a white-green suspension.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal treatment, drying, and calcination
nodes.procedure: For the hydrothermal process, the suspension and NF were then transferred into a reactor and allowed to react at 150 °C for 6 h. The NF was then washed with deionised water and EtOH and dried in a vacuum oven at 25 °C for 12 h. The obtained precursor was then calcined at 500 °C for 2 h in a H2/Ar (5:95) atmosphere to yield the Int-Ni/MoO2.

nodes.name: NiMo/MoO2 hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: A green-coloured solution was prepared by dissolving 0.44 g of (NH4)6Mo7O24 4 H2O and 0.42 g of Ni(NO3)2 6 H2O in 30 ml of deionised water. Then, a pre-cleaned NF (1.5 × 2.5 cm) was placed in the green solution and reacted at 150 °C for 6 h. The NF was then washed with deionised water and EtOH and dried in a vacuum oven at 25 °C for 12 h. The obtained precursor was then calcined at 500 °C for 2 h in a H2/Ar (5:95) atmosphere to yield NiMo/MoO2.

nodes.description: HER LSV performance in 1 M KOH three-electrode cell
nodes.source_text: The HER activity was measured in 1 M KOH (59.05 g KOH in 100 mL H₂O, pH = 13.78 ± 0.11) without IR compensation... LSV measurements were performed at a scan rate of 5 mV s⁻¹... Int-Ni/MoO₂ requires an overpotential of 46.4 ± 10.8 mV at -500 mA cm⁻²... 73.2 ± 14.2 mV at -1000 mA cm⁻².

nodes.description: HER long-term chronopotentiometry stability at -1000 mA/cm²
nodes.source_text: long-term stability for 6000 h at -1000 mA cm⁻²... operating for >6000 h without any discernible degradation... catalytic activity... did not show noticeable degradation after operating for more than 1000 h.

nodes.description: AEM-WE performance 1 cm² cell in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: In 1 cm² (1×1 cm) AEM-WE device, this noble-metal-free cell only requires 1.79 V (at 25 °C) and 1.59 V (at 80 °C) to reach 1000 mA cm⁻²... It achieves 7570 mA cm⁻² at 2.0 V... The long-term durability of the Int-Ni/MoO₂-assembled cell is demonstrated for 1000 h at a cell voltage of ~1.7 V with a degradation rate of 3.96 μV h⁻¹.

nodes.description: AEM-WE performance 25 cm² cell in 1 M KOH at 80°C
